system:
You write triage summaries of companies for a team that vets suppliers and project partners. The reader has about 30 seconds and must decide whether the company deserves a closer look.

Rules:
1. Use ONLY the facts provided. Never calculate, estimate or add outside knowledge. Copy figures exactly as written.
2. Lead with what matters most: the HIGH signals first, then MEDIUM. Mention INFO signals only if they add useful context.
3. If financial statements are missing, say so plainly. Never imply figures that are not provided.
4. State which financial year the latest figures are from, because they may be out of date.
5. Court cases that are not listed under the signals are settled, withdrawn, dismissed, or brought by the company itself. Do not present them as concerns.
6. Be neutral and factual. Do not recommend for or against doing business with the company.
7. 70 to 110 words. Plain Markdown, no headings.
prompt:
Write the summary for this company.

Structure: one opening sentence saying what the company is (name, industry, state, year incorporated), then the most important risks and facts, with the most serious first. If there are no significant signals, say so and give the headline financial position instead.

Company: Mutiara Delima Bakery Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000451)
Industry: Food & Beverage | State: Kuala Lumpur | Status: Active
Business: Mengusahakan kedai kopi dan kafe di Penang
Incorporated: 1995-08-28 | Share capital: RM500,000
Board: 5 director(s); 0 appointed in the 12 months to 31 Dec 2025
Largest shareholder: 50.6% (also a director)
Financial years available: FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 (latest year end 2024-06-30)
FY2022: revenue RM2.32m, profit after tax -RM180,391, equity RM524,275, operating cash flow -RM6,429, audit: Unqualified
FY2023: revenue RM2.25m, profit after tax -RM267,235, equity RM257,040, operating cash flow -RM104,978, audit: Unqualified
FY2024: revenue RM2.08m, profit after tax -RM275,562, equity -RM18,522, operating cash flow -RM138,894, audit: Unqualified
Court cases: 2 total (1 as defendant, 1 as plaintiff); open cases against company: 0
Risk and context signals (computed, already verified):
- [HIGH] Loss-making in each of the last 3 years; latest loss -RM275,562 (FY2024).
- [HIGH] Liabilities exceed assets: total equity is -RM18,522 (FY2024).
- [MEDIUM] Formerly 'Gemilang Ventures Sdn. Bhd.', renamed on 2025-11-27. The change is under 12 months old.
- [MEDIUM] Revenue fell 10% from RM2.32m (FY2022) to RM2.08m (FY2024).
- [MEDIUM] Operating cash flow was negative (-RM138,894) in FY2024.
- [MEDIUM] Operating profit does not cover interest expense in FY2024 (cover -5.4x).
- [MEDIUM] Current liabilities (RM950,085) exceed current assets (RM932,350) in FY2024.
response:
Mutiara Delima Bakery Sdn. Bhd. is a Food & Beverage company in Kuala Lumpur incorporated in 1995. 

High signals: The company has been loss-making in each of the last 3 years, with a latest loss of -RM275,562 in FY2024. Liabilities exceed assets, resulting in a total equity of -RM18,522 for FY2024. 

Medium signals: Formerly 'Gemilang Ventures Sdn. Bhd.', it was renamed on 2025-11-27. Revenue fell 10% from RM2.32m in FY2022 to RM2.08m in FY2024. Operating cash flow was negative at -RM138,894 in FY2024. Operating profit does not cover interest expense (-5.4x cover), and current liabilities of RM950,085 exceed current assets of RM932,350.
